universeReason: Fixed liquid majors plus assets discussed in this account; selected before outcomes, not a historical all-Binance universe
analysis: Closed 5m bars; rolling seven-day Wyckoff with two green candles before peak; next-open executions, no tick reconstruction
trendRule: Last completed UTC hourly close > SMA20, SMA20 > SMA50
currentExit: 10% initial loss stop; 80% gain retention activates after seven days, based on closes observed since entry
structureExit: Initial stop entry - 2.5 * entry ATR14, never farther than 10%; ratchet stop to highest observed close - 3 * current ATR14; after gain >= initial risk, two completed 5m closes below preceding 12-bar lowest low trigger exit; no minimum hold
positionSizing: Fixed one-fifth initial capital including entry fee; final free slot may use remaining cash after fee. Sale proceeds return to shared cash. No borrowing, one position per coin, new signal after exit required.
laterPeriod: Separately restarted portfolio for last20 days, using historical warmup only; all parameters fixed before outcomes. Not a future prospective holdout.
